function v_u_13.Refresh(p120, p121, p122) -- name: Refresh
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_119, (copy) v_u_7
	local v123 = 0
	local v124 = nil
	for v125 = 1, v_u_13.Copies do
		local v126 = p120.Slots[v125]
		local v127 = p121[v125]
		local v128 = v127 and (table.concat({ v127.Uid, v127.Id, v_u_13.Title(v127) }, "|") or "") or ""
		if v128 ~= v126.Look then
			v126.Look = v128
			v126.Entry = v127
			if v127 then
				v126.Name.Text = v_u_13.Title(v127)
				v_u_38(v126.Name, v127.Mutation)
				v126.Rarity.Text = v127.Rarity or "Common"
				v_u_9.Apply(v126.Rarity, v127.Rarity or "Common", {
					["Lighten"] = 0.5
				})
				v_u_6.SetArt(v126.Art, v127, {
					["TopRoom"] = 0
				})
				local v129 = v126.Art
				local v130 = v127.Mutation
				local v131 = v_u_12.Styles[v130]
				v129.ImageColor3 = v131 and Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(v131.Fill, 0.45) or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				if not p122 then
					v_u_10.Pop(v126.Card, 0.9, 0.25)
				end
			else
				v_u_6.SetArt(v126.Art, nil)
			end
		end
		local v132 = v127 ~= nil
		v126.EmptyLabel.Visible = not v132
		local v133 = v126.Add
		local v134 = not v132
		if v134 then
			v134 = not v126.Hold
		end
		v133.Visible = v134
		v126.Name.Visible = v132
		v126.Rarity.Visible = v132
		v126.Return.Visible = v132
		v126.Art.Visible = v132
		v_u_119(p120.Pipes[v125], v127 and 1 or 0, p122)
		if not v127 then
			continue
		end
		v123 = v123 + 1
		v124 = v124 or v127
	end
	p120.Count = v123
	if v123 == v_u_13.Copies then
		if p120.ResultLook ~= v124.Id then
			p120.ResultLook = v124.Id
			v_u_6.SetArt(p120.ResultArt, v124, {
				["TopRoom"] = 0
			})
			p120.ResultArt.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			v_u_10.Pop(p120.Result, 0.9, 0.3)
		end
		p120.ResultArt.Visible = true
		p120.ResultMark.Visible = false
	else
		if p120.ResultLook then
			p120.ResultLook = nil
			v_u_6.SetArt(p120.ResultArt, nil)
		end
		p120.ResultArt.Visible = false
		p120.ResultMark.Visible = true
	end
	if not p120.Busy then
		v_u_7.Enabled(p120.Fuse, v123 == v_u_13.Copies, v123 == v_u_13.Copies and "FUSE (Free)" or "Add " .. v_u_13.Copies - v123 .. " more")
	end
end

function v_u_13.PlayDrain(p_u_164, p_u_165) -- name: PlayDrain
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_1
	p_u_164.Busy = true
	v_u_7.Enabled(p_u_164.Fuse, false, "Fusing...")
	for v166, v_u_167 in p_u_164.Slots do
		v_u_167.Hold = true
		v_u_167.Return.Visible = false
		task.delay(p_u_165 * 0.25, function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_164, (copy) v_u_167, (ref) v_u_10
			if p_u_164.Busy then
				local v168 = v_u_167
				v168.EmptyLabel.Visible = true
				v168.Add.Visible = not v168.Hold
				v168.Name.Visible = false
				v168.Rarity.Visible = false
				v168.Return.Visible = false
				v168.Art.Visible = false
				v_u_10.Pop(v_u_167.Card, 1.06, 0.2)
			end
		end)
		local v169 = p_u_164.Pipes[v166]
		v169.FillValue.Value = 1
		local v170 = v169.DrainValue
		local v171 = p_u_165 * 0.85
		local v172 = Enum.EasingStyle.Linear
		v_u_1:Create(v170, TweenInfo.new(v171, v172 or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			["Value"] = 1
		}):Play()
	end
	task.delay(p_u_165 * 0.7, function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_164, (copy) p_u_165, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_10
		p_u_164.ResultFlash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
		local v173 = p_u_164.ResultFlash
		local v174 = p_u_165 * 0.6
		v_u_1:Create(v173, TweenInfo.new(v174, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			["BackgroundTransparency"] = 1
		}):Play()
		v_u_10.Pop(p_u_164.Result, 1.12, 0.3)
	end)
end

local function v_u_265(p231, p232) -- name: solveArm
	local v233 = p232 * p231.C0
	local v234 = p231.H - v233
	local v235 = v234.Magnitude
	local v236 = p231.L1 - p231.L2
	local v237 = math.abs(v236) + 0.01
	local v238 = p231.L1 + p231.L2 - 0.001
	local v239 = math.clamp(v235, v237, v238)
	local v240 = v234.Unit
	local v241 = p231.Side
	local v242 = Vector3.new(v241, -0.6, 0.15)
	local v243 = (v242 - v240 * v242:Dot(v240)).Unit
	local v244 = (p231.L1 ^ 2 + v239 ^ 2 - p231.L2 ^ 2) / (2 * p231.L1 * v239)
	local v245 = math.clamp(v244, -1, 1)
	local v246 = math.acos(v245)
	local v247 = v233 + v240 * (math.cos(v246) * p231.L1) + v243 * (math.sin(v246) * p231.L1)
	local v248 = v233 + v240 * v239
	local v249 = (v247 - v233).Unit
	local v250 = (v248 - v247).Unit
	local v251 = v249:Cross(v250)
	if v251.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		local v252 = p231.Side
		v251 = Vector3.new(0, 0, v252)
	end
	local v253 = p231.Side
	if v251:Dot((Vector3.new(0, 0, v253))) < 0 then
		v251 = -v251
	end
	local v254 = -v249.Unit
	local v255 = v251 - v254 * v251:Dot(v254)
	if v255.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
		v255 = v254:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
	end
	local v256 = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v255.Unit, v254) * p231.RestU:Inverse()
	local v257 = -v250.Unit
	local v258 = v251 - v257 * v251:Dot(v257)
	if v258.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
		v258 = v257:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
	end
	local v259 = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v258.Unit, v257) * p231.RestF:Inverse()
	local v260 = p231.Side
	local v261 = Vector3.new(0, 0, v260)
	local v262 = -(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)).Unit
	local v263 = v261 - v262 * v261:Dot(v262)
	if v263.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
		v263 = v262:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
	end
	local v264 = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), v263.Unit, v262) * p231.RestF:Inverse()
	return p232.Rotation:Inverse() * v256, v256:Inverse() * v259, v259:Inverse() * v264
end

function resetManagerListeners() -- name: resetManagerListeners
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if v_u_20 then
		v_u_20:Disconnect()
		v_u_20 = nil
	end
	if v_u_21 then
		v_u_21:Disconnect()
		v_u_21 = nil
	end
	if v_u_22 then
		v_u_22:Disconnect()
		v_u_22 = nil
	end
end
function teardownManager() -- name: teardownManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	resetManagerListeners()
	v_u_23 = nil
	v_u_24 = nil
end
function processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) -- name: processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (ref) v_u_22
	if p_u_28.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
		return false
	end
	if v_u_24 ~= p_u_28 then
		resetManagerListeners()
		v_u_23 = p_u_28.GroundSensor
		v_u_20 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_20
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_20:Disconnect()
				v_u_20 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_21 = p_u_28:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_28, (ref) v_u_21
			if processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p_u_28) then
				v_u_21:Disconnect()
				v_u_21 = nil
			end
		end)
		v_u_22 = p_u_28.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p29)
			if p29 == nil then
				resetManagerListeners()
				lookForControllerManager()
			end
		end)
		v_u_24 = p_u_28
	end
	return true
end
function setupManager(p_u_30) -- name: setupManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_24, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_20, (ref) v_u_21, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_22
	v_u_24 = p_u_30
	v_u_23 = p_u_30.GroundSensor
	v_u_20 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GroundSensor"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
		v_u_23 = v_u_24.GroundSensor
	end)
	v_u_21 = p_u_30:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_30, (ref) v_u_1
		if p_u_30.RootPart ~= v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
	v_u_22 = p_u_30.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, p31)
		if p31 == nil then
			teardownManager()
			lookForControllerManager()
		end
	end)
end
function lookForControllerManager() -- name: lookForControllerManager
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_27, (copy) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_23, (ref) v_u_24
	if v_u_27 then
		local v_u_32 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v_u_32 then
			if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
				setupManager(v_u_32)
			else
				local v_u_33 = nil
				v_u_33 = v_u_32:GetPropertyChangedSignal("RootPart"):Connect(function()
					-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_32, (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_33
					if v_u_32.RootPart == v_u_1.PrimaryPart then
						v_u_33:Disconnect()
						setupManager(v_u_32)
					end
				end)
			end
		else
			local v_u_34 = nil
			v_u_34 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p35)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_34
				if p35:IsA("ControllerManager") then
					v_u_34:Disconnect()
					lookForControllerManager()
				end
			end)
			return
		end
	else
		v_u_23 = nil
		v_u_24 = nil
		local v36 = v_u_1:FindFirstChildOfClass("ControllerManager")
		if v36 then
			processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(v36)
		end
		if v_u_24 == nil then
			local v_u_37 = nil
			v_u_37 = v_u_1.ChildAdded:Connect(function(p38)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_37
				if p38:IsA("ControllerManager") and processIfManagerBelongsToCharacter(p38) then
					v_u_37:Disconnect()
					v_u_37 = nil
				end
			end)
		end
		return
	end
end

function findExistingAnimationInSet(p39, p40) -- name: findExistingAnimationInSet
	if p39 == nil or p40 == nil then

	for v41 = 1, p39.count do

end
function configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43) -- name: configureAnimationSet
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_2
	if v_u_17[p_u_42] ~= nil then
		for _, v44 in pairs(v_u_17[p_u_42].connections) do
			v44:disconnect()
		end
	end
	v_u_17[p_u_42] = {}
	v_u_17[p_u_42].count = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = 0
	v_u_17[p_u_42].connections = {}
	local v_u_45 = true
	local function v46()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_45
		v_u_45 = game:GetService("StarterPlayer").AllowCustomAnimations
	end
	local v47, _ = pcall(v46)
	v_u_45 = not v47 and true or v_u_45
	local v48 = script:FindFirstChild(p_u_42)

			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43

		local v51 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
		local v52 = v48.ChildRemoved
		table.insert(v51, v52:connect(function(_)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
			configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
		end))
		for _, v53 in pairs(v48:GetChildren()) do
			if not v53:IsA("Animation") then
				continue
			end
			local v54 = v53:FindFirstChild("Weight")
			local v55 = v54 == nil and 1 or v54.Value
			v_u_17[p_u_42].count = v_u_17[p_u_42].count + 1
			local v56 = v_u_17[p_u_42].count
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v56] = {}
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v56].anim = v53
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v56].weight = v55
			v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v_u_17[p_u_42][v56].weight
			local v57 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v58 = v53.Changed
			table.insert(v57, v58:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
			local v59 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v60 = v53.ChildAdded
			table.insert(v59, v60:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
			local v61 = v_u_17[p_u_42].connections
			local v62 = v53.ChildRemoved
			table.insert(v61, v62:connect(function(_)
				-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_42, (copy) p_u_43
				configureAnimationSet(p_u_42, p_u_43)
			end))
		end
	end
	if v_u_17[p_u_42].count <= 0 then
		for v63, v64 in pairs(p_u_43) do
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63] = {}
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63].anim = Instance.new("Animation")
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63].anim.Name = p_u_42
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63].anim.AnimationId = v64.id
			v_u_17[p_u_42][v63].weight = v64.weight
			v_u_17[p_u_42].count = v_u_17[p_u_42].count + 1
			v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight = v_u_17[p_u_42].totalWeight + v64.weight
		end
	end
	for _, v65 in pairs(v_u_17) do
		for v66 = 1, v65.count do
			if v_u_16[v65[v66].anim.AnimationId] ~= nil then
				continue
			end
			v_u_2:LoadAnimation(v65[v66].anim)
			v_u_16[v65[v66].anim.AnimationId] = true
		end
	end
end

function getHeightScale() -- name: getHeightScale
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (ref) v_u_5
	if not v_u_2 then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	if not v_u_2.AutomaticScalingEnabled then
		return v_u_4()
	end
	local v102 = v_u_2.HipHeight / 2
	if v_u_5 == nil then
		v_u_5 = script:FindFirstChild("ScaleDampeningPercent")
	end
	if v_u_5 ~= nil then
		v102 = 1 + (v_u_2.HipHeight - 2) * v_u_5.Value / 2
	end
	return v102
end
local function v_u_108(p103) -- name: setRunSpeed
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14
	local v104 = p103 * 1.25 / getHeightScale()
	local v105 = 0.0001
	local v106 = 0.0001
	local v107 = 1
	if v104 <= 0.5 then
		v107 = v104 / 0.5
		v105 = 1
	elseif v104 < 1 then
		v106 = (v104 - 0.5) / 0.5
		v105 = 1 - v106
	else
		v107 = v104 / 1
		v106 = 1
	end
	v_u_11:AdjustWeight(v105)
	v_u_14:AdjustWeight(v106)
	v_u_11:AdjustSpeed(v107)
	v_u_14:AdjustSpeed(v107)
end

function keyFrameReachedFunc(p110) -- name: keyFrameReachedFunc
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_19, (ref) v_u_99, (ref) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_2
	if p110 == "End" then

				v_u_14.TimePosition = 0

			end
		else

			if v_u_99 then

					return

		end
	end
end
function rollAnimation(p114) -- name: rollAnimation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_17
	local v115 = math.random(1, v_u_17[p114].totalWeight)
	local v116 = 1
	while v_u_17[p114][v116].weight < v115 do
		v115 = v115 - v_u_17[p114][v116].weight
		v116 = v116 + 1
	end
	return v116
end
local function v_u_122(p117, p118, p119, p120) -- name: switchToAnim
	-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_14, (ref) v_u_13, (ref) v_u_9, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_17, (ref) v_u_15
	if p117 ~= v_u_10 then
		if v_u_11 ~= nil then
			v_u_11:Stop(p119)
			v_u_11:Destroy()
		end
		if v_u_14 ~= nil then
			v_u_14:Stop(p119)
			v_u_14:Destroy()
			v_u_14 = nil
		end
		v_u_13 = 1
		v_u_11 = p120:LoadAnimation(p117)
		v_u_11.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
		v_u_11:Play(p119)
		v_u_9 = p118
		v_u_10 = p117
		if v_u_12 ~= nil then
			v_u_12:disconnect()
		end
		v_u_12 = v_u_11.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		if p118 == "walk" then
			local v121 = rollAnimation("run")
			v_u_14 = p120:LoadAnimation(v_u_17.run[v121].anim)
			v_u_14.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Core
			v_u_14:Play(p119)
			if v_u_15 ~= nil then
				v_u_15:disconnect()
			end
			v_u_15 = v_u_14.KeyframeReached:connect(keyFrameReachedFunc)
		end
	end
end

	v_u_99 = false
